nodes.label: Liquidity Risk & Stress Testing Tool
nodes.summary: A Luxembourg ManCo-grade liquidity risk analytics platform for UCITS/AIFMD funds performing an end-to-end pipeline of profiling, stress testing, waterfall, and regulatory reporting.

nodes.label: LiquidityProfiler
nodes.summary: Engine that assigns liquidity buckets, computes haircuts, enforces ADV caps, and flags concentration for each position.

nodes.label: StressEngine
nodes.summary: Applies ESMA-style equity/credit/rate shocks, recomputes NAV impact, and re-profiles liquidity on the shocked portfolio.

nodes.label: RedemptionSimulator
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a fund can meet redemption outflows of 5/10/20/30% NAV within given settlement horizons, and applies LMTs.

nodes.label: WaterfallEngine
nodes.summary: Greedy and LP-optimised forced sell-down simulator that raises target cash by liquidating in bucket-priority order.

nodes.label: ReverseStressEngine
nodes.summary: On-demand multi-start SLSQP optimiser that finds the most plausible joint shock that breaches the redemption-coverage constraint.

nodes.label: LeverageEngine
nodes.summary: Computes AIFMD II Art.15 gross and commitment leverage and detects loan origination AIFs with risk-retention and borrower-concentration checks.

nodes.label: Validators
nodes.summary: Input validation module that checks positions and portfolios for bad data before pipeline processing.

nodes.label: RiskMetricsBuilder
nodes.summary: Aggregates regulatory KPIs (LCR, days-to-liquidate, concentration) into LiquidityMetrics.

nodes.label: ReportBuilder
nodes.summary: Exports results to Excel (6 sheets), JSON, and console with a SHA-256 run fingerprint.

nodes.label: Charts Visualization
nodes.summary: Matplotlib pack generating 7 charts including liquidity ladder, redemption heatmap, and waterfall schedule.

nodes.label: settings.py Configuration
nodes.summary: Central config holding all thresholds, haircuts, scenarios, and constants used by the engines.

nodes.label: Position / Portfolio Data Model
nodes.summary: Dataclasses (Position, ShareClass, Portfolio) forming the data foundation, including market_value_eur and effective_convexity properties.

nodes.label: CSV Loader
nodes.summary: Loads portfolios from holdings + NAV CSV files and enriches positions from market data.

nodes.label: Synthetic Data Generator
nodes.summary: Generates structurally identical but entirely fictional holdings, NAV, market data, and yield curves with zero real data.

nodes.label: Refinitiv Market Data Fetcher
nodes.summary: Extractor that pulls live market data from LSEG Workspace via its local proxy API; outputs are licensed data and must not be committed.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend
nodes.summary: Python API application (uvicorn) exposing routers and service wrappers for the pipeline.

nodes.label: React Frontend
nodes.summary: React + Vite + TailwindCSS v4 web UI with pages for portfolios, dashboard, stress, waterfall, charts, leverage, redemption, and LMT simulator.

nodes.label: Legacy Tkinter Desktop GUI
nodes.summary: Tkinter desktop application with 6 tabs running the pipeline on a background thread.

nodes.label: CLI Pipeline (main.py)
nodes.summary: Command-line entry point running the 8-step pipeline with optional flags for charts, single scenario, and LP waterfall.

nodes.label: LMT Simulator
nodes.summary: AIFMD II Liquidity Management Tools configurator and impact dashboard with an instant simulation endpoint that reuses cached run data.

nodes.label: Validation Service
nodes.summary: Backend service that reconciles position-sum NAV against the NAV file and checks waterfall/LMT consistency.

nodes.label: Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)
nodes.summary: Cumulative fraction of NAV liquidatable within a settlement horizon (T+1/T+3/T+7), adapted from the BCBS Basel III LCR concept.

nodes.label: Liquidity Ladder
nodes.summary: Distribution of portfolio market and realisable value across liquidity buckets (T+0 to >T+7), in both normal and stressed regimes.

nodes.label: Liquidity Bucket Assignment
nodes.summary: Classification of each position into T+0/T+1/T+3/T+7/>T+7 via worst-of asset-class and ADV-implied rules, with overrides.

nodes.label: Realisable Value & Haircuts
nodes.summary: Market value net of asset-class and bid-ask-spread haircuts, with a stress multiplier applied under scenarios.

nodes.label: ADV Participation Cap
nodes.summary: Maximum 20% of average daily volume that may be sold per day, sourced from MiFID II large-in-scale thresholds.

nodes.label: ADV Stress Scalar
nodes.summary: Volume-collapse factor compressing assumed daily trading capacity under stress (e.g. 0.50 in Severe Combined).

nodes.label: Equity Shock
nodes.summary: Beta-scaled CAPM-style price return applied to equity/ETF positions, capped at 50% single-position loss.

nodes.label: Credit Spread / Bond Repricing Shock
nodes.summary: Duration-convexity second-order repricing of bonds from rate and credit-spread shocks.

nodes.label: Redemption Scenario Analysis
nodes.summary: Coverage tests of 5/10/20/30% NAV redemptions against liquidity available at each horizon with a cash buffer.

nodes.label: Days-to-Liquidate Percentiles
nodes.summary: Greedy days required to liquidate 50/75/90% of NAV under the ADV participation cap.

nodes.label: Concentration Risk & Liq/Conc Ratio
nodes.summary: Top-10 investor concentration and the ratio of LCR T+1 to that concentration, testing simultaneous-redemption resilience.

nodes.label: Regulatory Flags
nodes.summary: Warning (<10% NAV) and breach (<5% NAV) flags on T+0/T+1 liquidity, plus geographical concentration.

nodes.label: Geographical Concentration Risk
nodes.summary: Country-of-risk concentration derived from ISIN prefixes across the 27 EU member states per AIFMD Annex IV.

nodes.label: Gross / Commitment Leverage
nodes.summary: AIFMD II Art.15 leverage measures (gross method and netted commitment method) with type-specific caps.

nodes.label: Swing Pricing
nodes.summary: NAV adjustment passing transaction costs to redeeming investors when net redemptions exceed a threshold.

nodes.label: Anti-Dilution Levy (ADL)
nodes.summary: Explicit basis-point levy on redeeming investors calibrated to transaction costs.

nodes.label: Liquidity Management Tools (LMT) Framework
nodes.summary: AIFMD II Art.16 + Annex V framework requiring at least two pre-selected tools; nine tools implemented including gate, suspension, swing pricing, ADL.

nodes.label: Stress Scenarios
nodes.summary: Six ESMA MMFR Art.28-aligned scenarios from Base to Severe Combined, each with equity/credit/rate shocks, ADV scalar, haircut multiplier, and redemption rate.

nodes.label: Severe Combined Scenario
nodes.summary: The most adverse scenario (ESMA MMFR Art.28 Scenario E) source of the stressed liquidity ladder; -20% equity, +300bps spread, 0.50x ADV, 2.0x haircut, 30% redemption.

nodes.label: Synthetic Demo Dataset
nodes.summary: Seven synthetic portfolios with distinct mandates, structurally identical to real inputs but containing zero real data, satisfying Refinitiv/LSEG license restrictions.

nodes.label: Loan Origination AIF Detection
nodes.summary: Classifies a fund as a loan AIF when >=50% NAV is in loans, applying stricter leverage caps, 5% risk retention, and 20% borrower concentration limits.

nodes.label: ESMA MMFR Article 28
nodes.summary: ESMA Money Market Fund Regulation stress-testing standard defining the scenario set (A-E).

nodes.label: AIFMD II (Directive (EU) 2024/927)
nodes.summary: Revised AIFMD effective April 2026 governing leverage (Art.15), LMTs (Art.16 + Annex V), and reverse stress testing.

nodes.label: UCITS LVLR
nodes.summary: UCITS liquidity profile / liquidity value-at-risk requirements informing LCR and gate thresholds.

nodes.label: AIFMD Annex IV
nodes.summary: AIFMD regulatory reporting template, including geographical concentration reporting across EU member states.

nodes.label: ESMA Liquidity Stress Testing Guidelines
nodes.summary: ESMA34-39-897 guidelines on liquidity classification (Guideline 2), reverse stress (Guideline 17), and investor concentration tests.

nodes.label: CSSF Circular 18/698
nodes.summary: Luxembourg CSSF circular informing worst-case scenario calibration and ESMA template output.

nodes.label: ESMA Template Export
nodes.summary: Excel sheet of 22 rows covering ESMA field codes A.1-E.6, pre-formatted for submission.

nodes.label: Public Upload Policy
nodes.summary: Governs what may be committed publicly; forbids Refinitiv/LSEG licensed data, real portfolio/client data, generated reports, and credentials.

nodes.label: MODEL.md Documentation
nodes.summary: Complete audit trail of every metric, its mathematical definition, and theoretical/regulatory basis.

nodes.label: README.md Documentation
nodes.summary: System architecture, module-by-module guide, full pipeline, configuration reference, and regulatory alignment.
